releases.notes:
### What's New
 - Fix `hurtLoopedPlayers`
 - Fix neoforge crash (patched mocap's fakeplayer)
 - Remove permission requirement for commands
 - Rename `/loop settings loopType ticks` to `/loop settings loopType duration`
 - Fix voice recording in death loop type
 - Fix other neoforge issues

The mod is now on CurseForge! Check it out here: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/time-loop

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vowless-dev/Time-Loop/compare/1.8...1.8.1

releases.notes:
### What's New
 - Fix `maxLoops` implementation
 - Fix `SLEEP` and `DEATH` loop type errors
 - Fix major error with loop not playing and subsequently breaking
 - Fix dimensions during loop
 - Add simple voice chat and voice chat interaction support
 - Add `/loop settings voice trackVoice`
 - Add `/loop settings voice showPlayerVoiceIcon`
 - Fixed server crash when player joins mid-loop

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/vowless-dev/Time-Loop/compare/1.7.9...1.8

releases.notes:
### What's New
 - Update mod for mocap 1.4-alpha-10
 - Add 1.21.5, 1.21.8 and 1.21.11 support
 - Add `stop_loop`, `keep_newest` and `keep_newest_delete` types for max loops. Also `disabled` of course
 - Add `skin_from_mineskin` and `skin_from_file` types for skin, alongside `skin_from_name`
 - Fix loop breaking when changing dimensions
 - Simplify commands
 - Fix loop always starting from the beginning even if it stopped in the middle of it
 - Simplify status command & more info available
 - Looped players can now hit each other and mobs

.. And probably much more that I forgot

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/VLTNOgithub/Time-Loop/compare/1.7.9...1.8-alpha-1
